title: One producer facade module opens the Queues binding on boot and emits producerReady with the queue name
asA: developer whose Worker or Node service needs a directed producer-to-consumer worklist behind a swappable boundary
iWant: one producer facade module to hold the Cloudflare Queues binding reference and expose typed domain verbs (publish, publishBatch), with a producerReady lifecycle event on the first successful ready-check
soThat: the boundary between my domain and the Queues vendor surface is the only place that has to move when the adapter changes, and boot ordering is observable via the event

acceptanceCriteria.description: On process boot, the facade opens against the elicited queue binding (env.RCF_TEST_QUEUE on the fixture); once the first successful ready-check returns, a producerReady event fires on the injected event sink with a payload containing queueName. The facade exposes typed named domain verbs (publish, publishBatch) and does not re-export the raw Queues binding.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a Worker or Node process with the facade module imported and its factory invoked with the elicited binding and queue name
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process boots and the facade ready-check returns
acceptanceCriteria.then: a producerReady event fires on the injected event sink with a payload containing queueName; the facade exposes named domain verbs (publish, publishBatch) and does not re-export the raw Queues binding

acceptanceCriteria.description: Exactly one source-tree module inside the facade directory holds the reference to the Cloudflare Queues binding (env.RCF_TEST_QUEUE in the fixture); every other module that publishes imports the facade and calls its named domain verbs, verified by a targeted grep on the applied fixture.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the applied project's source tree after apply
acceptanceCriteria.when: grep for a Queues binding dereference walks the tree outside the facade directory
acceptanceCriteria.then: no match is found outside the facade directory; the facade's public surface exports named domain verbs only, no raw binding reference
